answer: Each agent anchors a refundable capital bond keyed to its pubkey before it can trade or vote. A trust kernel then weights an identity only by attestation signals from already-bonded peers, so a fresh clone starts at zero weight. The marginal delta of adding one sybil is a full separate bond plus the slow work of earning real peer signal; forge a thousand fakes and you pay a thousand bonds. Faked signals are slashable, so attacker cost scales linearly per identity and idle clones decay to nothing.
